hero.zh: 不要滚动故事，直接选择空间。
hero.en: Do not scroll a story. Select the space.

intro.zh: 当用户需要比较楼层与房间，点击比滚动顺序更诚实。
intro.en: When readers compare floors and rooms, direct selection is more honest than a forced scroll sequence.

note.zh: 入口层连接公共展厅、服务台和无障碍路线。
note.en: The arrival level connects public galleries, service desk, and accessible circulation.

note.zh: 开放抽屉保存可触摸样本和出处记录。
note.en: Open drawers keep tactile samples with provenance records.

note.zh: 二层安静阅读区与数字档案并置。
note.en: A quiet second-floor reading room sits beside the digital archive.

note.zh: 观察窗让维护工作成为展览证据。
note.en: An observation window makes conservation work part of the evidence.

note.zh: 可变座席面向城市天际线和公共讲座。
note.en: Flexible seating faces the skyline and public lectures.

note.zh: 雨水、遮阳和本地植物成为实时教学系统。
note.en: Rainwater, shade, and native plants form a live teaching system.
